# Docs

- API Reference
  - [API Reference](/api): Package index for all 19 Kwiva packages — features, stability, exports map. Links to package pages (source of truth: kwivajs @ 552115f).
  - [@kwiva/core](/api/core): @kwiva/core — the application kernel: defineApp, defineConfig, config sections (app/logger/cache/kv), context/ALS (request/auth/batch/tx/tenant/afterResponse), errors, logger, model IR, cache, KV, store. Subpaths: ./helpers, ./collection, ./guards, ./html.
  - [@kwiva/data](/api/data): @kwiva/data — defineModel, fields, relations, query builder, transactions, migrations, seeders, factories, Postgres FTS, ./testing. Single source of truth for the schema.
  - [@kwiva/http](/api/http): @kwiva/http — controllers, contracts, middleware, server/pipeline, SSE/stream, WebSockets, OpenAPI, caching. HTTP layer.
  - [@kwiva/ui](/api/ui): @kwiva/ui — pages (definePage), layouts, routing, SSR/streaming/hydration, islands, navigation, SEO helpers, and the ./server subpath.
  - [@kwiva/client](/api/client): Typed RPC client — createClient, model endpoints, controller actions, typed errors, subscriptions, SSR safety, sessions, createTestClient.
  - [@kwiva/auth](/api/auth): @kwiva/auth — providers, sessions, identity, middleware, policies/gates, controllers, client hooks. defineAuth config.
  - [@kwiva/jobs](/api/jobs): @kwiva/jobs — defineJob, defineTask, queues, workers, middleware, outbox, cron scheduler, failed-job registry, metrics. (The successor of the old queue package page.)
  - [@kwiva/events](/api/events): @kwiva/events — defineEvent, defineListener, defineSubscriber, broadcast, broadcast metadata, queued listeners, config, fakes.
  - [@kwiva/mail](/api/mail): @kwiva/mail — defineMail, message delivery, markdown/string templates, transports (memory/console/smtp/resend), config, assets.
  - [@kwiva/mcp](/api/mcp): @kwiva/mcp — MCP v2 config, model + controller tool generation, custom tools, ./server handler + stdio, transports/auth, policy/tenant/audit enforcement.
  - [@kwiva/search](/api/search): @kwiva/search — config validation, Postgres FTS, federated searchAcross, reindex (model-integrated, CLI search:reindex).
  - [@kwiva/storage](/api/storage): @kwiva/storage — disks, uploads, signed URLs, assets, fakes, storage errors.
  - [@kwiva/testing](/api/testing): @kwiva/testing — withApp boot, createTestClient, bootAppFromRoot, DB lifecycle helpers, fake fakes (withApp / createTestClient / ./boot).
  - [@kwiva/cli](/api/cli): @kwiva/cli — the kwiva binary: 20 commands, 19 make kinds, defineCommand app commands, codegen (route-tree, entry bundles).
- Architecture
  - [Architecture](/architecture): Layered design, core rule, @kwiva/* packages.
  - [Design Principles](/architecture/design-principles): Four pillars + ADR-level decisions.
  - [Request Lifecycle](/architecture/request-lifecycle): Ordered pipeline, events, guarantees.
  - [Model Derivation](/architecture/model-derivation): One model → IR → DB/REST/RPC/Studio/OpenAPI/MCP.
  - [Frontend Architecture](/architecture/frontend-architecture): Pages/routing/loaders/streaming SSR/hydration/data hooks flow.
  - [Deployment Architecture](/architecture/deployment-architecture): Build-time-only deploy. One codebase, many targets.
  - [Package Boundaries](/architecture/package-boundaries): @kwiva/* graph, ownership, sealed engines, lint enforcement.
- Blog
  - [Welcome to Kwiva](/blog/welcome-to-kwiva): Kwiva 0.2.x is here — the batteries-included TypeScript framework that replaces the stitched-together stack.
  - [Why one defineX grammar](/blog/why-definex): The defineX convention isn't a stylistic choice — it's the mechanism that keeps a full-stack framework coherent. Here's the reasoning.
- Documentation
  - [What is Kwiva?](/docs): Kwiva is the batteries-included TypeScript application framework that replaces the stitched-together stack — one framework, one CLI, one defineX language, end-to-end.
  - Getting Started
    - [Installation](/docs/getting-started): Install Bun, scaffold a Kwiva project, and start the development server in minutes — one framework for data, APIs, auth, frontend, jobs, realtime and deploy.
    - [Create a Project](/docs/getting-started/create-project): kwiva new <name> — validation, scaffolding, package.json, bootstrap/src/config/src/app structure.
    - [Project Structure](/docs/getting-started/project-structure): Conventional Kwiva filesystem: bootstrap/, src/app/**, src/ui/**, src/config/, src/database/**, .kwiva/.
    - [Configuration](/docs/getting-started/configuration): src/config folder, precedence (built-ins → files → env), typed sections table.
    - [Development Server](/docs/getting-started/development-server): kwiva dev — build + watch, hot reload, SSE reload, debug options.
    - [Your First Model](/docs/getting-started/first-model): defineModel — one model = schema + migrations + REST + client + MCP tools.
    - [Your First API](/docs/getting-started/first-api): defineController + contracts + validation — typed ctx, routes, guards.
    - [Your First Page](/docs/getting-started/first-page): definePage — load, head, render, SSR, routing, types.
    - [Your First Deployment](/docs/getting-started/first-deployment): kwiva build → dist, runtime adapters, presets, deploy checklist.
  - Core Concepts
    - [Core Concepts](/docs/core-concepts): Mental model, concept map, architecture diagram, and language overview.
    - [The defineX Convention](/docs/core-concepts/definex): Every app-facing construct in Kwiva is a defineX factory — one grammar, one file per construct, across 19+ factories across 19 packages.
    - [Applications](/docs/core-concepts/applications): defineApp kernel/bootstrap composition.
    - [Configuration](/docs/core-concepts/configuration): Typed/layered/single-source config, entry + folder.
    - [Auto-Discovery](/docs/core-concepts/auto-discovery): Scan/register by convention, discovery map.
    - [Lifecycle](/docs/core-concepts/lifecycle): Boot sequence + 14-step request pipeline overview.
    - [Context](/docs/core-concepts/context): Request-scoped typed context — request/session/tenant/store/response.
    - [Services](/docs/core-concepts/services): defineService — DI in Kwiva.
    - [Modules](/docs/core-concepts/modules): defineModule — reusable packages, namespace.
    - [Plugins](/docs/core-concepts/plugins): definePlugin — extension points, lifecycle, app composition.
    - [Error Handling](/docs/core-concepts/error-handling): One taxonomy, two renderers, helper/exceptions, client handling.
    - [Type Inference](/docs/core-concepts/type-inference): Types flow end-to-end, no codegen.
  - Data
    - [Data](/docs/data): Data layer — models, queries, transactions, migration system, storage.
    - [Models](/docs/data/models): defineModel — one model = schema + migrations + REST + client + MCP tools. Single source of truth.
    - [Fields](/docs/data/fields): Field DSL — scalar types, enums, relations, modifiers.
    - [Relations](/docs/data/relations): belongsTo, hasOne, hasMany, manyToMany, through, polymorphic — querying + eager loading.
    - [Validation](/docs/data/validation): Layered validation — Standard Schema, field DSL, route-level contracts, errors.
    - [Queries](/docs/data/queries): Query builder — where, joins, raw, locks, limits, aggregates, dialect extensions.
    - [Pagination](/docs/data/pagination): Offset .page() and cursor .cursor() — envelopes, config, trade-offs, client hooks.
    - [Transactions](/docs/data/transactions): db.transaction, savepoints, outbox pattern (transactional outbox for events/jobs).
    - [Migrations](/docs/data/migrations): Diff-driven: defineMigration files, migrate, migrate:status, migrate:down, migrate:generate.
    - [Seeders](/docs/data/seeders): defineSeeder — idempotent seeders, ordered, run via kwiva seed.
    - [Factories](/docs/data/factories): defineFactory — test/dev factories for models.
    - [Soft Deletes](/docs/data/soft-deletes): Model option softDelete — deletedAt column; withTrashed/onlyTrashed/restore/forceDelete.
    - [Database Configuration](/docs/data/database-config): DatabaseConfig — drivers pglite/postgres, tenancy config.
    - [File Storage](/docs/data/storage): Storage facade + disks + uploads + signed URLs + fakes + assets (files-sdk, sealed).
    - [Cache](/docs/data/cache): Core cache — TTL, tags, wrap/remember, SWR, tenant-aware, multi-driver (memory/file/sqlite/redis/postgres).
    - [Search](/docs/data/search): Postgres FTS — model.search(), reindexSearch, probeSearch, federated searchAcross.
  - HTTP
    - [HTTP](/docs/http): Framework-owned pipeline — controllers, contracts, middleware, routes, guards, validation, errors, files, caching.
    - [Controllers](/docs/http/controllers): defineController — controllers, prefix, middleware, groups, routes, custom actions, guards.
    - [Routes & Routing](/docs/http/routes): URL conventions, manifest, server routes, versioning, auto-routes.
    - [Middleware](/docs/http/middleware): defineMiddleware, stack scoping, short-circuit, events, built-ins cors/csrf/rateLimit.
    - [Request Lifecycle](/docs/http/lifecycle): Full request pipeline — parse → validate → middleware → handler → output → error → response.
    - [Guards](/docs/http/guards): Guard scopes — route-level authorization guards, nesting, composition.
    - [Validation](/docs/http/validation): Route-level input validation — params/query/body/headers/cookies; Standard Schema; field-mapped errors.
    - [Errors](/docs/http/errors): Error taxonomy (8 codes), error handlers, custom errors, client handling.
    - [File Uploads](/docs/http/file-uploads): Multipart, ctx.file(), validation, storage integration.
    - [Streaming & SSE](/docs/http/streaming): stream(setup), SSE, heartbeat, client consumption via useWs or fetch.
    - [WebSockets](/docs/http/websockets): channels(), policy-checked subscriptions, presence, broadcast, event bridge, scaling notes.
    - [CORS & Security Headers](/docs/http/cors): cors, csrf, rateLimit built-ins; security headers defaults.
    - [Response Caching](/docs/http/caching): Route rules (cache, swr, isr, static, prerender) via ctx.response, model cache via @kwiva/data, client cache.
  - API
    - [API](/docs/api): Complete API layer — REST, generated endpoints, typed RPC, client SDK, OpenAPI, authentication, and errors.
    - [REST Conventions](/docs/api/rest): URL/method/status/envelope/pagination/naming/versioning — the 5 REST conventions Kwiva follows.
    - [Generated Endpoints](/docs/api/generated-endpoints): The 5 generated routes per model — query contracts, actions, permissions.
    - [Typed RPC](/docs/api/rpc): client.callRoute, Eden Treaty, typed navigation, routes from route-tree.gen.ts.
    - [Client SDK](/docs/api/client): @kwiva/client — initClient, useResource, useMutation, useUpload, useInfiniteList, useForm, WebSocket, cache persistence.
    - [OpenAPI](/docs/api/openapi): Auto-gen from manifest, /openapi.json, /docs (Scalar), shaping.
    - [API Authentication](/docs/api/authentication): Session cookies/tokens, auth surface, guards/permissions/CSRF/enumeration safety.
    - [API Errors](/docs/api/errors): Taxonomy, envelope, validation issues, custom codes, typed client handling.
  - Frontend
    - [Frontend](/docs/frontend): The complete frontend — pages, routing, layouts, loaders, data hooks, RPC client, and UI kit.
    - [Pages](/docs/frontend/pages): definePage contract — load, render, head, middleware, streamPage.
    - [File-Based Routing](/docs/frontend/routing): Routes from src/ui/pages/**; matchPath; dotted/param/splat conventions.
    - [Layouts](/docs/frontend/layouts): Root/nested layouts (listed).
    - [Loaders](/docs/frontend/loaders): Server loaders, deps/streaming (listed).
    - [Navigation](/docs/frontend/navigation): Typed navigation/Link/useNavigate — client-side routing, prefetch, scroll restoration.
    - [Data Hooks](/docs/frontend/data-hooks): @kwiva/client — useResource/useList/useMutation, optimistic mutations, cache, testing.
    - [RPC Client](/docs/frontend/rpc-client): Scoped client, SSR-safe dedupe, subscriptions, testing.
    - [UI Components](/docs/frontend/ui-components): Built-in UI kit: tokens/primitives/components/patterns/DataTable/forms/theming.
  - Rendering
    - [Rendering](/docs/rendering): SSR / streaming / hydration / caching / prerendering — Kwiva-owned rendering pipeline.
    - [Server-Side Rendering](/docs/rendering/ssr): Owned SSR orchestration, render pipeline, route rules.
    - [Streaming SSR](/docs/rendering/streaming): Suspense-aware streaming, deferred segments via stream(), client consumption.
    - [Hydration](/docs/rendering/hydration): Full hydration, typed reviver, cache transfer.
    - [Caching Strategies](/docs/rendering/caching): Route rules/model cache/client cache layers & invalidation.
    - [Static Generation](/docs/rendering/prerendering): Build-time prerender, crawl/explicit lists, ISR, SPA fallback.
  - Authentication
    - [Authentication](/docs/auth): defineAuth overview — providers, sessions, user contract, generated routes, client hooks.
    - [Auth Configuration](/docs/auth/configuration): Full defineAuth reference — providers, session/cookies, user contract, rate limits, hooks, trustProxy.
    - [Sessions](/docs/auth/sessions): createSession, getSession, HMAC cookies, rotation, lifecycle, useSession hook.
    - [Auth Providers](/docs/auth/providers): Password, magic link, OAuth (PKCE), behavior, routes, status codes.
    - [Protecting Routes](/docs/auth/protecting-routes): requireAuth, guestOnly, requirePermissions, authorization — middleware.
    - [Client-Side Auth](/docs/auth/client-usage): useSession, sign-in/out flows, session-aware hooks, SSR-safe rendering.
  - Authorization
    - [Authorization](/docs/authorization): Policies/permissions/roles overview — ability model.
    - [Policies](/docs/authorization/policies): definePolicy/defineGate, per-resource logic, abilities.
    - [Permissions](/docs/authorization/permissions): {resource}.{action} grammar, gating, ctx.can/authorize/useCan/whereCan.
    - [RBAC](/docs/authorization/roles): Role/permission fields, assignment/defaulting/seeding, policy interpretation.
    - [Enforcement Points](/docs/authorization/enforcement): Routes/Studio/channels/MCP/seeders/tasks checks — defense in depth.
  - Multi-Tenancy
    - [Multi-Tenancy](/docs/tenancy): Tenancy-first data access — tenants, modes, scoping, cache, storage isolation.
    - [Tenancy Configuration](/docs/tenancy/configuration): TenancyConfig — modes, tenantField, models, cache/storage scoping.
    - [Tenant Resolution](/docs/tenancy/resolution): Per-request resolution — middleware + typed ctx.tenant.
    - [Scoping](/docs/tenancy/scoping): Auto query scoping, write stamping, cross-tenant prevention/404.
    - [Tenant Isolation](/docs/tenancy/isolation): Storage/cache/queue/session/broadcast/audit isolation.
  - Realtime
    - [Realtime](/docs/realtime): Events/channels/broadcast/hooks/scaling overview.
    - [Channels](/docs/realtime/channels): channel() definitions, dynamic segments, policies, presence.
    - [Events & Broadcasting](/docs/realtime/events): defineEvent, listeners (queued/sync), broadcast mapping, metadata bridge.
    - [Client-Side Realtime](/docs/realtime/client-usage): useWsSubscription, useChannel(useChannel), typed payloads, SSE fallback.
    - [Scaling Realtime](/docs/realtime/scaling): Single vs multi-instance, fan-out/affinity/coordination.
  - Background Work
    - [Background Work](/docs/background-work): Jobs, queues, tasks, observability, agents. Jobs & queues, Tasks, Observability.
    - [Jobs](/docs/background-work/jobs): defineJob, dispatch, workers, retries, backoff, priority, idempotency.
    - [Queues & Workers](/docs/background-work/queues): createMemoryQueue, drivers (memory), worker start, concurrency, DLQ.
    - [Scheduled Tasks](/docs/background-work/scheduling): defineTask, parseCron, startScheduler, timezones, preventOverlapping.
    - [Job Observability](/docs/background-work/observability): queueMetrics, onJobEvent, failedJobs, retries, correlation.
  - AI & MCP
    - [AI & MCP](/docs/ai-mcp): MCP integration overview — generated tools, security, transports, audit.
    - [MCP Server](/docs/ai-mcp/mcp-server): Enable/config, stdio vs streamable HTTP, auth, transports, security, agent clients.
    - [Tool Generation](/docs/ai-mcp/tool-generation): Model CRUD tools + controller actions + custom defineMcpTool + IR-shaped schemas.
    - [Agent Integration](/docs/ai-mcp/agent-integration): Policy/permission/tenant enforcement, validation, errors, audit for tool calls.
  - Modules & Plugins
    - [Modules & Plugins](/docs/modules-plugins): Package-level composition — modules vs plugins/addons, defineModule, defineApp, definePlugin.
    - [Defining Modules](/docs/modules-plugins/defining-modules): defineModule — package factories, exports, namespace, contributions.
    - [Addons & Distribution](/docs/modules-plugins/addons): Install, search, version, and publish Kwiva addons — modules, plugins, and themes — through a single workflow built on kwiva add and the addon registry.
    - [Application Composition](/docs/modules-plugins/composition): defineApp assembly — module merge/boot/shutdown.
  - CLI
    - [CLI](/docs/cli): kwiva — the only CLI. Commands: dev, build, test, create, migrate, seed, task, route:list, key:generate, doctor.
    - [Project Commands](/docs/cli/project-commands): kwiva dev/build/test/create — scaffold, dev, build, test.
    - [Generators](/docs/cli/generators): kwiva make:* — 19 kinds with suffixes and dated migrations.
    - [Database Commands](/docs/cli/database-commands): kwiva migrate, migrate:status, migrate:down, migrate:generate, seed.
    - [Addon Commands](/docs/cli/addon-commands): Registry/search/install/publish — not implemented. Skipped per decision; addon feature is roadmap.
  - Testing
    - [Testing](/docs/testing): Pyramid (unit/integration/api/e2e/type), @kwiva/testing harness, withApp, createTestClient, bootAppFromRoot, DB lifecycle.
    - [Unit Testing](/docs/testing/unit-testing): Services, policies, jobs, factories in isolation (withApp teardown patterns).
    - [Integration Testing](/docs/testing/integration-testing): withApp, DB traits, in-process client, composition tests.
    - [API Testing](/docs/testing/api-testing): createTestClient — contracts/responses/errors/permissions/tenant/auth.
    - [E2E Testing](/docs/testing/e2e-testing): Browser runner, projects per mode, fixtures, CI placement.
  - Observability
    - [Observability](/docs/observability): Correlation story — logging, tracing, metrics, dev overlay.
    - [Logging](/docs/observability/logging): Structured JSON logs, correlation fields, dev/prod output.
    - [Tracing](/docs/observability/tracing): Span trees per request/work, exporters, correlation IDs.
    - [Metrics](/docs/observability/metrics): Counters/durations, pipeline sampling, export.
    - [Dev Overlay](/docs/observability/dev-overlay): Live timeline/waterfall/errors/queries/cache during kwiva dev.
  - Security
    - [Security](/docs/security): Defense-in-depth — validation, CSRF, cookie hardening, rate limits, tenant isolation defaults.
    - [Default Protections](/docs/security/default-protections): Validation, CSRF, cookie hardening, rate limits, tenant isolation defaults.
    - [Input Validation](/docs/security/input-validation): Typed validation at every boundary, Standard Schema, field map DSL.
    - [Headers](/docs/security/headers): Default security headers/CSP/overrides.
    - [Production](/docs/security/production): Env-gated config, secrets/typed env, preflight/hardening checklist.
  - Deployment
    - [Deployment](/docs/deployment): Build-time-only deploy, .output/, one codebase many targets.
    - [Runtime Adapters](/docs/deployment/adapters): Presets/adapters, selection/auto-detect, target shapes (node/bun/serverless/container).
    - [Node/Bun Deployment](/docs/deployment/node-bun): Node/bun presets, run/startup/env/process, binary notes.
    - [Serverless Deployment](/docs/deployment/serverless): Function output, stateless constraints, streaming/cold-start notes.
    - [Container Deployment](/docs/deployment/containers): Minimal images, entrypoint/PORT, migrations on boot, scaling/shared stores.
    - [Production Checklist](/docs/deployment/production-checklist): Stateless rules, externalized state, migrations/secrets/health/workers/observability.
  - Advanced
    - [Advanced](/docs/advanced): Internals overview — architecture/lifecycle/IR/boundaries/performance.
    - [Architecture Internals](/docs/advanced/architecture-internals): Layers, ownership, discovery, module boundaries.
    - [Request Lifecycle](/docs/advanced/request-lifecycle): Detailed request sequence — middleware, hooks, context, errors, tracing.
    - [Model IR](/docs/advanced/model-ir): IR contents, derivation pipeline, .kwiva artifacts, no-drift guarantee.

    - [Performance](/docs/advanced/performance): Bun runtime, streaming SSR, layered caching, type-level inference.

- Guides
  - [Guides](/guides): How-to guides for Kwiva — create, protect, integrate, test, deploy.
  - [How do I create a model?](/guides/create-model): kwiva make:model + defineModel — schema, migration, verify.
  - [How do I create a controller?](/guides/create-controller): kwiva make:controller, defineController handlers, verify via curl.
  - [How do I validate input?](/guides/validate-input): Field-level DSL + route-level validation via Standard Schema + contracts.
  - [How do I paginate results?](/guides/pagination): Offset .page() and cursor .cursor() — envelope, config, client hooks.
  - [How do I protect a route?](/guides/protect-routes): requireAuth, guestOnly, permission guards, page beforeLoad redirects.
  - [How do I add authentication?](/guides/authentication): Users model, defineAuth, sessions, hooks, client session, SSR-safe rendering.
  - [How do I add a policy?](/guides/policies): definePolicy, permissions, route wiring, ctx.can.
  - [How do I handle file uploads?](/guides/file-uploads): ctx.file(), validation, storage integration.
  - [How do I create a background job?](/guides/background-jobs): kwiva make:job, defineJob, dispatch, worker, retry.
  - [How do I schedule a task?](/guides/schedule-tasks): defineTask, src/config/schedule.ts, cron/overlap/manual, timezone.
  - [How do I enable realtime?](/guides/realtime): channel(), policy-checked subscriptions, events/broadcast, client hooks.
  - [How do I configure tenancy?](/guides/tenancy): TenancyConfig — mode, tenantField, models, cache/storage scoping.
  - [How do I generate OpenAPI docs?](/guides/openapi): Route-manifest-derived spec, /openapi.json, docs UI, shaping.
  - [How do I deploy?](/guides/deploy): Modes/targets, presets, .output/, migrate-on-boot, shared stores.
